questions.text: Which company makes the iPhone?
Which company develops the Android operating system?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Alphabet.

questions.text: Which social network did Mark Zuckerberg co-found in 2004?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: TheFacebook, its original name.

questions.text: What video-sharing site, founded in 2005, did Google buy in 2006?
What is the name of Apple's voice assistant?
Which brand made the nearly indestructible 3310 phone?
Who co-founded Microsoft with Paul Allen in 1975?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Gates.

questions.text: What blue-branded mobile wallet app do millions of Filipinos use to pay bills and send money?
What do you call unwanted junk email sent in bulk?
On a Windows computer, what keyboard shortcut copies selected text?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Control C. On a Mac it is Command + C.

questions.text: What do you call a harmful program that spreads by copying itself onto other files or computers?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: computer virus, worm, malware.

questions.text: What does the "e" in "email" stand for?
What do you call the small picture you tap or click on a screen to open an app?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: app icon.

questions.text: In computing, what does "PC" stand for?
What three-letter abbreviation names the part of a computer often called its "brain"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: central processing unit, processor.

questions.text: Who co-founded Apple with Steve Wozniak in 1976?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Jobs. Ronald Wayne was a third, short-lived co-founder.

questions.text: Which Chinese company makes the Redmi line of smartphones?
In 2023, Twitter was renamed to what single letter?
What social network, hugely popular in the Philippines before Facebook, let friends post "testimonials"?
questions.hostNotes: Not Multiply or MySpace.

questions.text: Which telco owns the prepaid brand TNT, or "Talk 'N Text"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Smart Communications. Not Globe, whose prepaid brand is TM.

questions.text: What is the main circuit board inside a computer called?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: mainboard, logic board.

questions.text: What number system, using only 0s and 1s, do computers use?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: base 2.

questions.text: How many bits are in one byte?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: 8.

questions.text: Which popular programming language shares its name with a large snake?
questions.hostNotes: It was actually named after the comedy group Monty Python.

questions.text: What is the term for a fake email or site that tricks you into giving away your password?
questions.hostNotes: Done by text message, it is called smishing.

questions.text: What is the name of the small data file a website stores in your browser?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: browser cookie, HTTP cookie.

questions.text: Which company created ChatGPT?
The Philippines was once called the "texting capital of the world". What does SMS stand for?
The "Y2K bug" was feared to crash computers at the start of which year?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: year 2000.

questions.text: In what year was the first iPhone released?
In "QR code", what do the letters "QR" stand for?
Bluetooth technology is named after a king from which country?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Danish. King Harald "Bluetooth" Gormsson united Danish tribes in the 10th century.

questions.text: What Apple computer, launched in 1984, helped popularize the mouse and on-screen windows?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Mac, Apple Macintosh.

questions.text: What 2000 computer worm, traced to a Filipino student, spread by email posing as a romantic confession?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: I Love You virus, Love Bug, Love Letter.

questions.text: What was Google's original name when it began as a research project in 1996?
Which British mathematician helped crack the Enigma code and proposed a test for machine intelligence?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Turing.

questions.text: Which British scientist invented the World Wide Web in 1989?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Berners-Lee.

questions.text: Which Chinese company bought IBM's PC business in 2005, including the ThinkPad line?
A processor's clock speed is measured in what unit?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: gigahertz, GHz, megahertz.

questions.text: Which company released the 4004, the first commercially available microprocessor, in 1971?
What did the Philippine telco name PLDT originally stand for?
questions.hostNotes: Accept without "Company". The company was renamed PLDT Inc. in 2016.

questions.text: Which 19th-century Englishwoman is often called the first computer programmer?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Lovelace, Augusta Ada King. She was poet Lord Byron's daughter.

questions.text: Which English inventor designed the Analytical Engine, earning the title "father of the computer"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Babbage.

questions.text: What room-sized 1940s machine is often called the first general-purpose electronic computer?
questions.hostNotes: Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer, built at the University of Pennsylvania.

questions.text: Which Filipino inventor patented the "Sing-Along System", a karaoke machine?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: del Rosario. Japan's Daisuke Inoue built an early karaoke machine too.
